name: Post Extra – Blog Posts Plugin for WordPress Block Editor (Post Grid, Post Carousel, Recent Posts, post List)
author: Anant Sites

sections.description:
Post Extra is the ultimate Gutenberg block plugin for WordPress, designed to create stunning News, Magazine, and Blog websites with ease. Display your posts in dynamic layouts, including Post Grids, Post Lists, and Post Sliders. With advanced customization options and seamless integration, Post Extra empowers you to build visually captivating sites that stand out. Boost your website’s engagement and traffic with a plugin that’s fast, flexible, and optimized for performance. Perfect for bloggers, news publishers, and content creators looking to elevate their online presence—no coding required!

Everything is accessible through an easy drag-and-drop interface, including features like header-footer builder, arhive builder, single post builder complete site builder, and more – all designed to expand your Gutenberg capabilities.

Completely Customizable

Each block and extension comes packed with flexible options, allowing you to customize your website in every possible way and bring any design you imagine to life.

Light Weight & Instant Loading

No extra resources or messy codes to slow down your website. Optimized for super fast loading and instant Live editing.

Block Control Option

Take full control of your blocks — activate only the ones you need to keep your website fast and optimized. Disable unused elements to reduce bloat and improve performance.

KEY FEATURES

⭐ 28+ Free Blocks

⭐ Full Site Builder

⭐ Header & Footer Builder

⭐ Single Post Builder

⭐ Single Archive Builder

⭐ Beneficial Post Blocks

⭐ Copy Paste feature

⭐ Fully Responsive Blocks for mobile, desktop, & tab

⭐ No extra loading time for web pages.

⭐ Expert support team available 24/7

sections.faq:
What is the plugin license?

  • This plugin is released under a GPL license.

What themes do Post Extra For Gutenberg support?

  • Post Extra for Gutenberg has no theme dependency. This Gutenberg blocks plugin is compatible with any updated WordPress theme.

Will Post Extra slow down my website speed?

  • No, Post Extra will not slow down your website. This Gutenberg blocks plugin brings you the outstanding facility of complete modular control over the activation of each individual block. We have also used optimized codes for this plugin which helps to load only the resources that are currently used.

Is Post Extra Responsive for Smaller Devices?

  • Also, the Gutenberg blocks available with Post Extra plugin are 100% responsive and have cross-browser compatibility. So it is responsive on smaller devices as well.

Is it working with old version of WordPress?

  • It works great with WordPress version 6 or more. And WordPress old version with Gutenberg plugin.

Does Post Extra Blocks has any plugin dependency?

  • You only need the Gutenberg block editor to use Post Extra Blocks plugin on your WordPress website. Then you can use Post Extra Blocks and create stunning pages.
